title: Terms of Sale — Acceptance of Online Orders
content:
An Online Orders order is opened when a customer places it on the Marlowe & Finch website or app. It opens in status placed, carrying its delivery service, shipping address, totals and any promotion code, and each line of merchandise or gift card is booked on it at placement.

## Conditions of acceptance

**1. Destination served by the delivery service.** An order is accepted only for a delivery service that serves its destination:
   - an Alaska or Hawaii address only on a service that can ship to Alaska or Hawaii;
   - a PO box only on a service that can deliver to a PO box;
   - an APO, FPO or DPO military address only on a service that can deliver to such an address;
   - Same-Day Courier only for ZIP codes on the Same-Day metro list, the service area of that service.

**2. Order total.** An order is accepted only if its total does not exceed the highest order total the chosen service accepts.

**3. Units.** An order is accepted only if it carries no more than the service's maximum units per order, and no more than the service's maximum units of any one SKU.

**4. Gift card lines.** A gift card line is worth at most the highest value of one purchased gift card, and cannot be paid with stored value.

**5. Fraud review.** An order whose total reaches the service's fraud review threshold is held in status placed for fraud review for up to the service's fraud review hold, in hours.

**6. Clearance lines.** Lines sold at a clearance price are marked final sale.

The service-specific figures named in these clauses (destinations served, highest order total, unit limits, gift card value, fraud review threshold and hold) are those published for each Online Orders delivery service.

## Acceptance at a glance

| Feature of the order | Accepted when |
|---|---|
| Alaska or Hawaii address | The service can ship to Alaska or Hawaii |
| PO box | The service can deliver to a PO box |
| APO, FPO or DPO address | The service can deliver to military addresses |
| Same-Day Courier chosen | The ZIP code is on the Same-Day metro list |
| Order total | Not above the service's highest order total |
| Units on the order | Not above the per-order and per-SKU limits |
| Gift card line | Not above the single gift card value; not paid with stored value |

## Boundaries of the clauses (hypothetical orders)

- An order total exactly equal to the service's highest order total does not exceed it, so clause 2 is met; one cent more and it is not.
- An order total exactly equal to the fraud review threshold reaches it, so the order is held for review under clause 5.
- A clearance-price line is final sale from placement under clause 6; a regular-price or flash-sale line is not made final sale by that clause.
